decisionsTitle: «Activitatea ta pe Strava»: the runner's own link to their race, from their registration page, beside their name in the published results (migration 0231)
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-11-22**, the day after the race: «cât de greu ar fi să-i las să-și pună link către activitate strava din aplicație?» Proposed: a box on the runner's own registration page, the link beside their name in the published results and only there, one nullable column; he answered «da».

**Decision.**

- **Where it is written.** The registration's own manage page (the link in every registration email; runners have no account) gains a block «Activitatea ta pe Strava» per person: a box «Linkul activității pe Strava», «Salvează linkul», and «Scoate linkul» once one is saved. Drawn for a confirmed registration at a race from the race's start — before it there is no activity — and, wherever a link is saved, always with the way out. The token is read, never spent; POST only, GET writes nothing (BR-REQ-036-02). Per person as every block of the page (§547); another adult on the address may have their link taken off from this page, never written (§421). Staff never write it.
- **What is accepted.** One activity on strava.com, however it was copied — with or without the scheme and `www.`, `/overview` or a share query after the number — kept as `https://www.strava.com/activities/<id>` (`stravaActivityUrl`, `registrations/social-links.ts`). Never the app's `strava.app.link`: a public page never prints a redirector beside a runner's name (§500); the box's help says to open it in a browser and copy the page's address. Anything else is refused with that sentence and nothing is written.
- **Where it is stored.** `registrations.strava_activity_url` (migration 0231, expand only: one nullable column) — on the registration, not on the result, so it is deleted with the registration (an erase, the retention sweep). It is not the profile of §106 (`strava_url`), which the platform never publishes.
- **Where it shows.** The published results print the Strava mark (`StartListSocials`, the public list's own, §500) beside the runner's name, a 44-pixel link to the activity, new tab, `nofollow ugc`, no referrer — **only on a registered runner's row the page names**: on a «Participant #bib» row the link would say who that is, so the read returns none there (`readPublicEventResults`), and it checks the address again rather than trust the row. The published results are expired after each change.
- **The trail.** One audit row `registration.strava_activity_changed` per change, `to: set | cleared` and the door — never the link, which names its athlete (AGENTS.md §12.12). The same link twice writes nothing.
- **The privacy notice.** The link is the runner's own, typed to be published, and the block says where it shows before the box. Whether the club's privacy notice should also name it is the club's to decide when it next approves the notice; nothing here waits for it.

**Tests.** `tests/unit/registrations/strava-activity-url.test.ts`, `tests/integration/registrations/strava-activity.test.ts`; the public read's keys in `tests/integration/results/results.test.ts` and `typed-name.test.ts`.
changelogLine: - **Linkul către activitatea Strava**: din pagina înscrierii, alergătorul își pune linkul activității de la cursă (`strava.com/activities/…`) și clasamentul publicat îl arată cu iconița Strava lângă numele lui — doar acolo unde numele apare. Migrarea 0231. §NNN.
